# netactuate_dedicated_disk_layouts (Data Source)

Reads Dedicated Disk Layouts visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_dedicated_disk_layouts" "example" {
  os_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `os_id` (Number) Dedicated OS profile ID to read disk layouts for.

### Read-Only

- `disk_layouts` (List of Object) List of dedicated disk layouts. The API field named id is exposed as layout_id because Terraform reserves id for resource state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk_layouts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--disk_layouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk_layouts`

Read-Only:

- `layout_id` (Number)
- `min_disks` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `profile` (String)
